borrower_id_card_upload_intents_lifecycl.name: borrower_id_card_upload_intents_lifecycle_check
borrower_id_card_upload_intents_lifecycl.value:
("borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."status" = 'pending' AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."finalized_at" IS NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."apply_request_hash" IS NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."idempotency_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."status" = 'ready' AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."apply_request_hash" IS NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."idempotency_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."status" = 'applied' AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."apply_request_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("borrower_id_card_upload_intents"."idempotency_key") <> '')

floating_penalty_ledger_adjustment_check.name: floating_penalty_ledger_adjustment_check
floating_penalty_ledger_adjustment_check.value:
("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."entry_type" IN ('fixed_assessment', 'daily_percent_accrual') AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."adjusts_entry_id" IS NULL AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'legacy_snapshot' AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."amount" >= 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."adjusts_entry_id" IS NULL AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason")) > 0)
        OR ("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'legacy_cutover' AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."amount" = 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."opening_interest_basis" = 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."late_fee_mode" = 'none' AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."late_fee_value" = 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."grace_period_days" = 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."adjusts_entry_id" IS NULL AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."source_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason")) > 0)
        OR ("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'adjustment' AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."amount" <> 0 AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."adjusts_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("floating_penalty_ledger_entries"."reason")) > 0)

floating_transaction_allocations_entry_t.name: floating_transaction_allocations_entry_type_check
floating_transaction_allocations_entry_t.value:
("floating_transaction_allocations"."entry_type" = 'payment' AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."amount" > 0 AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."reversed_allocation_id" IS NULL AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("floating_transaction_allocations"."entry_type" = 'reversal' AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."amount" < 0 AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."reversed_allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("floating_transaction_allocations"."reason")) > 0)

floating_transaction_allocations_interes.name: floating_transaction_allocations_interest_target_check
floating_transaction_allocations_interes.value:
("floating_transaction_allocations"."component" = 'interest' AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."interest_accrual_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("floating_transaction_allocations"."component" = 'penalty' AND "floating_transaction_allocations"."interest_accrual_id" IS NULL)

intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.name: intermediated_disbursement_group_previews_amount_check
intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.value:
"intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_funding_amount" >= 0 AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_funding_amount" >= 0
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_borrower_payout_amount" >= 0 AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_borrower_payout_amount" >= 0
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_advance_interest_return_amount" >= 0 AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_advance_interest_return_amount" >= 0
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."retained_balance_amount" >= 0

intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.name: intermediated_disbursement_group_previews_money_scale_check
intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.value:
scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_funding_amount") <= 2 AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_funding_amount") <= 2
        AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_borrower_payout_amount") <= 2 AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_borrower_payout_amount") <= 2
        AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_advance_interest_return_amount") <= 2 AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_advance_interest_return_amount") <= 2
        AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."retained_balance_amount") <= 2 AND scale("intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."variance_amount") <= 2

intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.name: intermediated_disbursement_group_previews_money_finite_check
intermediated_disbursement_group_preview.value:
"intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_funding_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_funding_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_borrower_payout_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_borrower_payout_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."expected_advance_interest_return_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."actual_advance_interest_return_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."retained_balance_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_group_previews"."variance_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)

intermediated_disbursement_groups_money_.name: intermediated_disbursement_groups_money_finite_check
intermediated_disbursement_groups_money_.value:
"intermediated_disbursement_groups"."expected_funding_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."expected_borrower_payout_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."expected_advance_interest_return_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
        AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."retained_balance_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)

intermediated_disbursement_groups_comman.name: intermediated_disbursement_groups_command_keys_check
intermediated_disbursement_groups_comman.value:
"intermediated_disbursement_groups"."idempotency_key" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
        AND ("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."post_idempotency_key" IS NULL OR "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."post_idempotency_key" ~ '[^[:space:]]')
        AND ("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NULL OR "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_idempotency_key" ~ '[^[:space:]]')
        AND ("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_request_hash" IS NULL OR "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_request_hash" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

intermediated_disbursement_groups_lifecy.name: intermediated_disbursement_groups_lifecycle_check
intermediated_disbursement_groups_lifecy.value:
("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."status" IN ('draft', 'needs_review', 'ready')
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_group_id" IS NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."posted_at" IS NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."status" = 'posted'
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_group_id" IS NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."post_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("intermediated_disbursement_groups"."status" = 'reversed'
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_request_hash" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
            AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_disbursement_groups"."reversal_reason" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

intermediated_transfer_events_lifecycle_.name: intermediated_transfer_events_lifecycle_check
intermediated_transfer_events_lifecycle_.value:
("intermediated_transfer_events"."status" IN ('draft', 'ready')
            AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_event_id" IS NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."posted_at" IS NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("intermediated_transfer_events"."status" = 'posted'
            AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_event_id" IS NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("intermediated_transfer_events"."status" = 'reversed'
            AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "intermediated_transfer_events"."reversal_reason" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents_.name: intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents_lifecycle_check
intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents_.value:
("intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents"."status" = 'pending' AND "intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents"."finalized_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents"."status" = 'ready' AND "intermediated_transfer_evidence_intents"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_c.name: loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_check
loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_c.value:
("loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" IS NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_days" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" > "loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date"
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" BETWEEN 1 AND COALESCE(
                "loan_interest_accruals"."period_days",
                CASE "loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" WHEN 'week' THEN 7 ELSE 1 END
            )
            AND ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_days" IS NULL
                OR ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" = 'day' AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_days" = 1)
                OR ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" = 'week' AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_days" = 7))
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" >= 0)

loan_interest_accruals_period_date_order.name: loan_interest_accruals_period_date_order_check
loan_interest_accruals_period_date_order.value: "loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date" IS NULL OR "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" IS NULL OR "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" > "loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date"

loan_interest_accruals_period_day_index_.name: loan_interest_accruals_period_day_index_check
loan_interest_accruals_period_day_index_.value:
"loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" IS NULL OR (
            "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" >= 1
            AND ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" = 'day' AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" <= 1
                OR "loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" = 'week' AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" <= 7)
        )

loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_c.name: loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_completeness_check
loan_interest_accruals_period_snapshot_c.value:
("loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" IS NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_length" IS NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."contractual_interest_amount" IS NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" IS NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."daily_increment_amount" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("loan_interest_accruals"."period_start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_end_date" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_day_index" IS NOT NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_unit" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."period_length" IS NOT NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."contractual_interest_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" IS NOT NULL
            AND "loan_interest_accruals"."daily_increment_amount" IS NOT NULL)

loan_interest_accruals_period_amounts_ch.name: loan_interest_accruals_period_amounts_check
loan_interest_accruals_period_amounts_ch.value:
("loan_interest_accruals"."contractual_interest_amount" IS NULL OR "loan_interest_accruals"."contractual_interest_amount" >= 0)
        AND ("loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" IS NULL OR "loan_interest_accruals"."cumulative_interest_amount" >= 0)
        AND ("loan_interest_accruals"."daily_increment_amount" IS NULL OR "loan_interest_accruals"."daily_increment_amount" >= 0)

loan_intermediary_assignments_lifecycle_.name: loan_intermediary_assignments_lifecycle_check
loan_intermediary_assignments_lifecycle_.value: ("loan_intermediary_assignments"."status" = 'active' AND "loan_intermediary_assignments"."effective_to" IS NULL) OR ("loan_intermediary_assignments"."status" = 'ended' AND "loan_intermediary_assignments"."effective_to" IS NOT NULL)

loan_restructure_waivers_reversal_check.name: loan_restructure_waivers_reversal_check
loan_restructure_waivers_reversal_check.value:
("loan_restructure_waivers"."status" = 'executed' AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."audit_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND
            ("loan_restructure_waivers"."actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructure_waivers"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND
            "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_waiver_id" IS NULL AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversal_request_hash" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("loan_restructure_waivers"."status" = 'reversed' AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."audit_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND
            ("loan_restructure_waivers"."actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructure_waivers"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND
            "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_waiver_id" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversal_request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND
            ("loan_restructure_waivers"."actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "loan_restructure_waivers"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL)

loan_restructures_actor_sources_check.name: loan_restructures_actor_sources_check
loan_restructures_actor_sources_check.value:
"loan_restructures"."created_actor_source" IN ('web', 'mcp', 'system') AND
        ("loan_restructures"."execute_actor_source" IS NULL OR "loan_restructures"."execute_actor_source" IN ('web', 'mcp', 'system')) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" IS NULL OR "loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" IN ('web', 'mcp', 'system'))

loan_restructures_amounts_check.name: loan_restructures_amounts_check
loan_restructures_amounts_check.value:
"loan_restructures"."gross_principal" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."gross_interest" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."gross_fees" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."gross_penalty" >= 0 AND
        "loan_restructures"."waived_interest" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."waived_fees" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."waived_penalty" >= 0 AND
        "loan_restructures"."net_principal" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."net_interest" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."net_fees" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."net_penalty" >= 0 AND
        "loan_restructures"."external_settlement_credits" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."additional_principal" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."cash_amount" >= 0 AND
        "loan_restructures"."waived_interest" <= "loan_restructures"."gross_interest" AND "loan_restructures"."waived_fees" <= "loan_restructures"."gross_fees" AND "loan_restructures"."waived_penalty" <= "loan_restructures"."gross_penalty" AND
        "loan_restructures"."external_credit_principal" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."external_credit_interest" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."external_credit_fees" >= 0 AND "loan_restructures"."external_credit_penalty" >= 0 AND
        "loan_restructures"."external_settlement_credits" = "loan_restructures"."external_credit_principal" + "loan_restructures"."external_credit_interest" + "loan_restructures"."external_credit_fees" + "loan_restructures"."external_credit_penalty" AND
        "loan_restructures"."net_principal" = "loan_restructures"."gross_principal" - "loan_restructures"."external_credit_principal" AND
        "loan_restructures"."net_interest" = "loan_restructures"."gross_interest" - "loan_restructures"."waived_interest" - "loan_restructures"."external_credit_interest" AND
        "loan_restructures"."net_fees" = "loan_restructures"."gross_fees" - "loan_restructures"."waived_fees" - "loan_restructures"."external_credit_fees" AND
        "loan_restructures"."net_penalty" = "loan_restructures"."gross_penalty" - "loan_restructures"."waived_penalty" - "loan_restructures"."external_credit_penalty"

loan_restructures_amount_scale_check.name: loan_restructures_amount_scale_check
loan_restructures_amount_scale_check.value:
scale("loan_restructures"."gross_principal") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."gross_interest") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."gross_fees") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."gross_penalty") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."waived_interest") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."waived_fees") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."waived_penalty") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."net_principal") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."net_interest") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."net_fees") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."net_penalty") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."external_settlement_credits") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."external_credit_principal") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."external_credit_interest") <= 2 AND
        scale("loan_restructures"."external_credit_fees") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."external_credit_penalty") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."additional_principal") <= 2 AND scale("loan_restructures"."cash_amount") <= 2

loan_restructures_request_key_hash_check.name: loan_restructures_request_key_hash_check
loan_restructures_request_key_hash_check.value:
("loan_restructures"."execute_idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("loan_restructures"."execute_request_hash" IS NULL) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("loan_restructures"."reversal_request_hash" IS NULL)

loan_restructures_lifecycle_check.name: loan_restructures_lifecycle_check
loan_restructures_lifecycle_check.value:
("loan_restructures"."created_actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructures"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."status" NOT IN ('executed', 'reversed') OR (
            "loan_restructures"."new_loan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."old_loan_id" <> "loan_restructures"."new_loan_id" AND
            "loan_restructures"."execute_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."execute_request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."executed_audit_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."execute_actor_source" IS NOT NULL AND
            ("loan_restructures"."execute_actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructures"."executed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        )) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."status" <> 'executed' OR (
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversal_request_hash" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_audit_public_id" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_by_user_id" IS NULL
        )) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."status" <> 'reversed' OR (
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_audit_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND
            ("loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" = 'system' OR "loan_restructures"."reversed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        )) AND
        ("loan_restructures"."status" NOT IN ('preview', 'expired') OR (
            "loan_restructures"."new_loan_id" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."execute_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."execute_request_hash" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."execute_actor_source" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."executed_audit_public_id" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."executed_at" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."executed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversal_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversal_request_hash" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversal_actor_source" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_audit_public_id" IS NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "loan_restructures"."reversed_by_user_id" IS NULL
        ))

loan_restructures_pre_execution_snapshot.name: loan_restructures_pre_execution_snapshot_check
loan_restructures_pre_execution_snapshot.value:
"loan_restructures"."status" NOT IN ('executed', 'reversed') OR (
            jsonb_typeof("loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state") = 'object' AND
            "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" ->> 'status' IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" ->> 'outstandingPrincipal' IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" ->> 'outstandingInterest' IS NOT NULL AND
            "loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state" ->> 'outstandingFees' IS NOT NULL AND
            jsonb_path_exists("loan_restructures"."pre_execution_old_loan_state", '$.nextDueDate')
        )

loan_settlement_previews_amounts_check.name: loan_settlement_previews_amounts_check
loan_settlement_previews_amounts_check.value:
"loan_settlement_previews"."outstanding_principal" >= 0 AND "loan_settlement_previews"."due_interest" >= 0
        AND "loan_settlement_previews"."accrued_not_due_interest" >= 0 AND "loan_settlement_previews"."outstanding_fees" >= 0
        AND "loan_settlement_previews"."outstanding_penalties" >= 0 AND "loan_settlement_previews"."non_refundable_advance_interest" >= 0
        AND "loan_settlement_previews"."settlement_total" >= 0

loan_waiver_previews_lifecycle_check.name: loan_waiver_previews_lifecycle_check
loan_waiver_previews_lifecycle_check.value:
("loan_waiver_previews"."status" IN ('preview', 'expired') AND "loan_waiver_previews"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("loan_waiver_previews"."status" = 'consumed' AND "loan_waiver_previews"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)

loans_single_payment_terms_check.name: loans_single_payment_terms_check
loans_single_payment_terms_check.value:
("loans"."repayment_type" <> 'single_payment' AND
            "loans"."single_payment_due_date" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_fixed_agreed_interest" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_interest_policy" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate_type" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_mode" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day" IS NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_grace_days" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("loans"."repayment_type" = 'single_payment' AND
            "loans"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND
            "loans"."single_payment_due_date" > "loans"."start_date" AND
            "loans"."single_payment_fixed_agreed_interest" IS NOT NULL AND
            (
                ("loans"."single_payment_interest_policy" = 'fixed_only' AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate_type" IS NULL AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("loans"."single_payment_interest_policy" = 'greater_of_fixed_or_retroactive' AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate_type" IN ('percent_per_day', 'per_thousand_per_day') AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate" IS NOT NULL)
            ) AND
            (
                ("loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_mode" = 'none' AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day" IS NULL AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_grace_days" IS NULL)
                OR
                ("loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_mode" = 'fixed_amount_per_day' AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day" IS NOT NULL AND
                    "loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_grace_days" >= 0)
            ))

loans_floating_accrual_cycle_check.name: loans_floating_accrual_cycle_check
loans_floating_accrual_cycle_check.value:
("loans"."repayment_type" = 'floating' AND "loans"."floating_accrual_cycle" IN ('daily', 'weekly'))
        OR ("loans"."repayment_type" <> 'floating' AND "loans"."floating_accrual_cycle" IS NULL)

loans_single_payment_money_check.name: loans_single_payment_money_check
loans_single_payment_money_check.value:
("loans"."single_payment_fixed_agreed_interest" IS NULL OR
            ("loans"."single_payment_fixed_agreed_interest" >= 0 AND scale("loans"."single_payment_fixed_agreed_interest") <= 2)) AND
        ("loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate" IS NULL OR
            ("loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate" >= 0 AND scale("loans"."single_payment_retroactive_rate") <= 4)) AND
        ("loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day" IS NULL OR
            ("loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day" >= 0 AND scale("loans"."single_payment_late_penalty_amount_per_day") <= 2))

loans_interest_period_policy_completenes.name: loans_interest_period_policy_completeness_check
loans_interest_period_policy_completenes.value:
("loans"."interest_period_unit" IS NULL AND "loans"."interest_period_length" IS NULL
            AND "loans"."advance_interest_periods" IS NULL AND "loans"."advance_interest_refund_policy" IS NULL
            AND "loans"."interest_period_anchor_date" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("loans"."interest_period_unit" IS NOT NULL AND "loans"."interest_period_length" IS NOT NULL
            AND "loans"."advance_interest_periods" IS NOT NULL AND "loans"."advance_interest_refund_policy" IS NOT NULL
            AND "loans"."interest_period_anchor_date" IS NOT NULL)

loans_activation_command_completeness_ch.name: loans_activation_command_completeness_check
loans_activation_command_completeness_ch.value:
("loans"."activation_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "loans"."activation_result" IS NULL)
        OR ("loans"."activation_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "loans"."activation_result" IS NOT NULL)

transactions_entry_type_reference_check.name: transactions_entry_type_reference_check
transactions_entry_type_reference_check.value: ("transactions"."entry_type" = 'repayment' AND "transactions"."reversed_transaction_id" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."entry_type" = 'reversal' AND "transactions"."reversed_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)
